title: Discrete foundations: polygons, turning angles, realizability

blocks.tex: The cyclic polygon is indexed by $\mathbb Z/n$. The edge lengths are free variables; target curvatures determine the incident half-angles. These definitions fix the development and its geometric constraints.

blocks.label: def:discrete_trig
blocks.title: generalized sine, cosine, tangent
blocks.body:
For $K, x \in \mathbb{R}$ set
  \[
    s_K(x) = \begin{cases} \sin x & K = 1\\ \sinh x & K = -1\\ x &
    \text{otherwise,}\end{cases}
    \qquad
    c_K(x) = \begin{cases} \cos x & K = 1\\ \cosh x & K = -1\\ 1 &
    \text{otherwise,}\end{cases}
    \qquad
    t_K(x) = \frac{s_K(x)}{c_K(x)}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cK
lean.code:
noncomputable def cK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if K = 1 then Real.cos x else if K = -1 then Real.cosh x else 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sK
lean.code:
noncomputable def sK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if K = 1 then Real.sin x else if K = -1 then Real.sinh x else x

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tK
lean.code:
noncomputable def tK (K x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sK K x / cK K x

blocks.label: lem:discrete_trig_cases
blocks.title: case evaluation

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cK_zero
lean.code: @[simp] lemma cK_zero (x : ℝ) : cK 0 x = 1 := by norm_num [cK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tK_neg_one
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma tK_neg_one (x : ℝ) : tK (-1) x = Real.tanh x := by
  rw [tK, sK_neg_one, cK_neg_one, Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]

/-! ## Polygon data, moderate arcs, and the turning-angle law -/

variable {n : ℕ}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cK_one
lean.code: @[simp] lemma cK_one (x : ℝ) : cK 1 x = Real.cos x := by simp [cK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cK_neg_one
lean.code: @[simp] lemma cK_neg_one (x : ℝ) : cK (-1) x = Real.cosh x := by norm_num [cK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sK_zero
lean.code: @[simp] lemma sK_zero (x : ℝ) : sK 0 x = x := by norm_num [sK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sK_neg_one
lean.code: @[simp] lemma sK_neg_one (x : ℝ) : sK (-1) x = Real.sinh x := by norm_num [sK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tK_one
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma tK_one (x : ℝ) : tK 1 x = Real.tan x := by
  rw [tK, sK_one, cK_one, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sK_one
lean.code: @[simp] lemma sK_one (x : ℝ) : sK 1 x = Real.sin x := by simp [sK]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tK_zero
lean.code: @[simp] lemma tK_zero (x : ℝ) : tK 0 x = x := by simp [tK]

blocks.tex:
Immediate from the definition and the quotient identities
  $\tan = \sin/\cos$, $\tanh = \sinh/\cosh$.

blocks.title: Polygon data, moderate arcs, and the turning-angle law

blocks.tex:
Throughout, $n$ is a natural number (with $n \neq 0$, and $3 \le n$ where
stated), curvature data is $\kappa\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$ and edge
lengths are $\ell\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$; the cyclic index arithmetic
lives in $\mathbb{Z}/n$, while cumulative (lifted) quantities are defined
through the ordered lift $j \mapsto (j : \mathbb{Z}/n)$ over
$\mathrm{range}$-sums.

blocks.label: def:moderate_arc
blocks.title: strict moderate-arc domain

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc

blocks.title: remark
blocks.body:
For $K \in \{0,-1\}$ condition (2) is automatic from $0 < \ell_i$; for
$K = 1$ it encodes $\ell_i < \pi$ (half-lengths in the principal branch of
$\tan$), which keeps $t_1(\ell_i/2)$ positive and the arcsin arguments
honest. The wall is \emph{strict}: this is what makes every turning angle
strictly less than $\pi$ (\cref{lem:turning_angle_lt_pi}), the load-bearing
strictness in the positive-support obstruction. Geometrically the class
restricts every subtended arc to strictly less than half its cycle.

blocks.label: lem:moderate_arc_accessors
blocks.title: moderate-arc accessors

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.wall_right
lean.code:
lemma wall_right (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) :
    |κ i| * tK K (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := (h i).2.2.2.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.length_pos
lean.code: lemma length_pos (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) : 0 < ℓ i := (h i).1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.tK_pos
lean.code:
lemma tK_pos (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) : 0 < tK K (ℓ i / 2) :=
  div_pos (h i).2.1 (h i).2.2.1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ModerateArc.wall_left
lean.code:
lemma wall_left (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ) (i : ZMod n) :
    |κ i| * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := (h i).2.2.2.1

blocks.tex:
Projections of the conjuncts of \cref{def:moderate_arc}; positivity of
  $t_K = s_K/c_K$ is the quotient of the two positive-branch conditions.

blocks.label: lem:moderate_arc_zero
blocks.title: moderate arc at $K=0$
blocks.body:
$\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$ holds if and only if for every $i$:
  $0<\ell_i$, $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_{i-1}/2 < 1$ and $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_i/2 < 1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.moderateArc_zero_iff
lean.code:
lemma moderateArc_zero_iff {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} :
    ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ↔ ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < ℓ i ∧ |κ i| * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 ∧ |κ i| * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨h1, _, _, h4, h5⟩ := h i
    rw [tK_zero] at h4 h5
    exact ⟨h1, h4, h5⟩
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h i
    exact ⟨h1, by simpa using half_pos h1, by simp, by simpa using h2, by simpa using h3⟩

blocks.tex:
At $K=0$, $s_0(x)=x$, $c_0(x)=1$, $t_0(x)=x$; condition (2) of
  \cref{def:moderate_arc} reduces to $0<\ell_i/2$, already implied by (1).

blocks.label: def:turning_angle
blocks.title: turning angle, (TA)
blocks.body:
The turning angle at vertex $i$ of the data $(K,\kappa,\ell)$ is
  \[
    \theta_i \;=\; \arcsin\bigl(\kappa_i\, t_K(\ell_{i-1}/2)\bigr)
             \;+\; \arcsin\bigl(\kappa_i\, t_K(\ell_i/2)\bigr).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningAngle (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) + Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_neg
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_neg (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) :
    turningAngle K (-κ) ℓ i = -turningAngle K κ ℓ i := by
  simp [turningAngle, neg_mul, Real.arcsin_neg]
  ring

blocks.label: lem:turning_angle_sign
blocks.title: sign of the turning angle
blocks.body:
Under $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,K\,\kappa\,\ell$: if $\kappa_i > 0$ then
  $\theta_i > 0$; if $\kappa_i < 0$ then $\theta_i < 0$; if $\kappa_i = 0$
  then $\theta_i = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_pos
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_pos {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    {i : ZMod n} (hκ : 0 < κ i) : 0 < turningAngle K κ ℓ i :=
  add_pos (Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hκ (h.tK_pos (i - 1))))
    (Real.arcsin_pos.2 (mul_pos hκ (h.tK_pos i)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_neg_of_neg
lean.code:
lemma turningAngle_neg_of_neg {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    {i : ZMod n} (hκ : κ i < 0) : turningAngle K κ ℓ i < 0 :=
  add_neg (Real.arcsin_lt_zero.2 (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hκ (h.tK_pos (i - 1))))
    (Real.arcsin_lt_zero.2 (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hκ (h.tK_pos i)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle_eq_zero

blocks.tex:
The positive-branch condition gives $t_K(\ell_j/2) = s_K/c_K > 0$ on both
  adjacent edges, so each $\arcsin$ argument $\kappa_i\, t_K(\ell_j/2)$ has
  the strict sign of $\kappa_i$, and $\arcsin$ is strictly monotone with
  $\arcsin 0 = 0$; the sum of two terms of the same strict sign has that
  sign.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.abs_turningAngle_lt_pi
lean.code:
lemma abs_turningAngle_lt_pi {K : ℝ} {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc K κ ℓ)
    (i : ZMod n) : |turningAngle K κ ℓ i| < Real.pi := by
  have key : ∀ j : ZMod n, |κ i| * tK K (ℓ j / 2) < 1 →
      |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ j / 2))| < Real.pi / 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have habs : |κ i * tK K (ℓ j / 2)| < 1 := by
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (h.tK_pos j)]
    rw [abs_lt] at habs ⊢
    exact ⟨Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arcsin.2 habs.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.2 habs.2⟩
  have h1 := key (i - 1) (h.wall_left i)
  have h2 := key i (h.wall_right i)
  calc |turningAngle K κ ℓ i|
      ≤ |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2))| +
        |Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ < Real.pi := by linarith

/-! ## Euclidean development and closure -/

blocks.tex:
Both arcsin arguments have absolute value
  $|\kappa_i|\cdot t_K(\ell_j/2) < 1$ (strict wall; $t_K > 0$ lets the
  absolute value pass through the product), so each $\arcsin$ lies strictly
  inside $(-\pi/2, \pi/2)$ and the sum lies strictly inside $(-\pi,\pi)$.

The Euclidean ($K=0$) development turns the data into a polygonal path in
$\mathbb{C}$. The convention: edge $j$ leaves vertex $j$ after the turn at
vertex $j$, so edge $j$ has heading $\psi_j = \sum_{m \le j}\theta_m$.
Cumulative quantities are defined on the ordered lift ($j \in \mathbb{N}$,
indices cast into $\mathbb{Z}/n$).

blocks.label: def:discrete_development
blocks.title: headings, vertices, closure error
blocks.body:
For $j, k \in \mathbb{N}$:
  \[
    \psi_j = \sum_{m=0}^{j} \theta_{(m : \mathbb{Z}/n)}, \qquad
    v_k = \sum_{j=0}^{k-1} \ell_{(j:\mathbb{Z}/n)}\,
          e^{i \psi_j} \in \mathbb{C},
  \]
  with $\theta$ the $K=0$ turning angles of \cref{def:turning_angle}. The
  \emph{closure gap} is $E(\kappa,\ell) = v_n \in \mathbb{C}$ and the
  \emph{turning sum} is
  $T(\kappa,\ell) = \sum_{i \in \mathbb{Z}/n} \theta_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.closureGap
lean.code:
noncomputable def closureGap (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℂ :=
  vertexR2 κ ℓ n

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningSum
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningSum [NeZero n] (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def vertexR2 (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
    (ℓ (j : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ j : ℂ) * Complex.I)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading
lean.code:
noncomputable def heading (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), turningAngle 0 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n)

blocks.label: lem:development_recurrences
blocks.title: development recurrences
blocks.body:
The vertex map satisfies the one-step recurrence
  $v_{k+1} = v_k + \ell_{(k:\mathbb{Z}/n)}\,e^{i\psi_k}$; the heading over a
  full period shifts by the turning sum,
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + T(\kappa,\ell)$; and for any additive monoid $M$ and
  $g\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to M$,
  $\sum_{m=0}^{a+n-1} g_{(m:\mathbb{Z}/n)}
    = \sum_{m=0}^{a-1} g_{(m:\mathbb{Z}/n)} + \sum_{i\in\mathbb{Z}/n} g_i$
  (a period block of a lifted cyclic sum equals the full cyclic sum).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_add_n
lean.code:
lemma heading_add_n [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (j : ℕ) :
    heading κ ℓ (j + n) = heading κ ℓ j + 2 * Real.pi := by
  unfold heading
  rw [show j + n + 1 = (j + 1) + n from by ring,
    Finset.sum_range_add (fun m => turningAngle 0 κ ℓ (m : ZMod n)) (j + 1) n,
    sum_range_natCast_add (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ) (j + 1)]
  rw [show (∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) = turningSum κ ℓ from rfl, hT]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_succ
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_succ (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      + (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
  Finset.sum_range_succ _ _

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sum_range_natCast_add
lean.code:
lemma sum_range_natCast_add {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [NeZero n]
    (f : ZMod n → M) (a : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ∑ i : ZMod n, f i := by
  have base : ∀ g : ZMod n → M,
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, g (m : ZMod n) = ∑ i : ZMod n, g i := by
    intro g
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => g (m : ZMod n)) n]
    exact Fintype.sum_bijective (fun i : Fin n => ((i : ℕ) : ZMod n))
      ⟨fun a b hab => Fin.ext (by
          simpa [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt a.isLt, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt b.isLt] using
            congrArg ZMod.val hab),
        fun z => ⟨⟨z.val, z.val_lt⟩, ZMod.natCast_rightInverse z⟩⟩
      _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n)
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i)) (m : ZMod n) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        push_cast
        rfl
    _ = ∑ i : ZMod n, (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i)) i :=
        base (fun i => f ((a : ZMod n) + i))
    _ = ∑ i : ZMod n, f i :=
        Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft ((a : ℕ) : ZMod n)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

blocks.tex:
The recurrence is the last term of the range sum defining $v_{k+1}$. The
  reindexing identity splits $\mathrm{range}(a+n)$ and reindexes the tail
  block by $m\mapsto m+a$, whose casts $(m+a:\mathbb{Z}/n)$ run over all of
  $\mathbb{Z}/n$ once; the heading shift is its specialization to
  $g = \theta$.

blocks.label: lem:development_periodic
blocks.title: periodicity of the closed development
blocks.body:
If $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$ and $T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$, then
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$ and $v_{k+n} = v_k$ for all $j,k$; in
  particular the vertex map descends to a well-defined polygon
  $\mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{C}$, $i \mapsto v_{i.\mathrm{val}}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexR2_add_n
lean.code:
lemma vertexR2_add_n [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) :
    vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + n) = vertexR2 κ ℓ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa [closureGap, vertexR2] using hE
  | succ k ih =>
    have hedge : (ℓ ((k + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + n) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      have h1 : ((k + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = (k : ZMod n) := by
        push_cast [ZMod.natCast_self]
        ring
      have h2 : ((heading κ ℓ k + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
          = (heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h1, heading_add_n hT, h2, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    rw [show k + 1 + n = (k + n) + 1 from by ring, vertexR2_succ, vertexR2_succ, ih, hedge]

blocks.tex:
Splitting the range sum, $\psi_{j+n} - \psi_j$ is a sum of $n$ consecutive
  turning angles whose indices run over all of $\mathbb{Z}/n$ exactly once,
  hence equals $T = 2\pi$; therefore $e^{i\psi_{j+n}} = e^{i\psi_j}$ and the
  edge vectors are $n$-periodic in $j$, so
  $v_{k+n} - v_k = \sum_{j=k}^{k+n-1} \ell\, e^{i\psi} = e^{i\psi_{k}}\cdot
  (\text{rotation of } E) = 0$; concretely, the block of $n$ consecutive
  edge vectors starting at $k$ is the block starting at $0$ rotated by the
  common phase, and the latter sums to $E = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def polygonR2 (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ZMod n → ℂ :=
  fun i => vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val

/-! ## Simple polygons and realizability -/

blocks.label: def:simple_polygon
blocks.title: simple polygon

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon
lean.code:
def IsSimplePolygon (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ZMod n, v i ≠ v (i + 1)) ∧
    (∀ i : ZMod n,
      segment ℝ (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 1 + 1))
        = {v (i + 1)}) ∧
    (∀ i j : ZMod n, i ≠ j → i + 1 ≠ j → j + 1 ≠ i →
      segment ℝ (v i) (v (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (v j) (v (j + 1)) = ∅)

blocks.label: def:discrete_realizes
blocks.title: Euclidean discrete realizability
blocks.body:
$\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$ holds when there exist edge lengths
  $\ell\colon\mathbb{Z}/n\to\mathbb{R}$ with
  \[
    \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell, \qquad
    E(\kappa,\ell) = 0, \qquad
    T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi, \qquad
    \mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}\,\bigl(P(\kappa,\ell)\bigr).
  \]
  \emph{Non-degeneracy (standing definitional directive, user @085): every
  realization must have strictly positive edge lengths, $\ell_j > 0$ ---
  a zero-length edge collapses two vertices, making the object an
  $(n{-}1)$-gon. This clause is ALREADY carried by the first conjunct of
  \cref{def:moderate_arc} (\texttt{ModerateArc.length\_pos}), so the
  definition as stated satisfies the directive; no change was needed.}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesR2
lean.code:
def RealizesR2 [NeZero n] (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ, ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ∧ closureGap κ ℓ = 0 ∧
    turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi ∧ IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ)

/-! ## The constant profile closes -/

blocks.title: remark
blocks.body:
The normalization $T = 2\pi$ is the positive-orientation gauge: the
program's constructions always produce it, and the obstruction statements of
\cref{chap:discrete_budget} address the reflected gauge $T = -2\pi$ through
the oddness symmetry \cref{lem:turning_angle_neg}. The bridge from (TA) to
the circumcycle phrasing (each triple $(P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1})$ lies on a
circle of signed curvature $\kappa_i$) is the tangent--chord equivalence,
deferred to the forthcoming \texttt{TangentChord} chapter; the chord-level
consequence needed early — the Menger chord identity — is proved directly in
\cref{chap:discrete_budget}.

blocks.tex:
A first sanity target validating the definitional layer end to end: the
regular $n$-gon closes the constant profile. (Its \emph{simplicity} — hence
the full constant branch of the discrete Gluck converse — follows once the
discrete convexity lemma L1 lands with the closing engine; it is not needed
for the obstruction chapter.)

blocks.label: lem:regular_gon_closes
blocks.title: regular polygon closes the constant profile
blocks.body:
Let $3 \le n$, $c > 0$, and set $\ell_i = (2/c)\sin(\pi/n)$ for all $i$.
  Then for the constant profile $\kappa \equiv c$:
  $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$, every turning angle equals
  $2\pi/n$, $T = 2\pi$, and $E(\kappa,\ell) = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularGon_closes
lean.code:
theorem regularGon_closes {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ModerateArc 0 (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) ∧
      (∀ i : ZMod n,
        turningAngle 0 (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) i
          = 2 * Real.pi / n) ∧
      turningSum (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
      closureGap (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
        (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 0 := by
  have hn3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hπn_pos : 0 < Real.pi / n := div_pos Real.pi_pos hnpos
  have hπn_le : Real.pi / n ≤ Real.pi / 3 := by gcongr
  have hπn_lt_half : Real.pi / n < Real.pi / 2 := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi / n) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hπn_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin_lt : Real.sin (Real.pi / n) < 1 := by
    rw [← Real.sin_pi_div_two]
    exact Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two (by linarith) le_rfl hπn_lt_half
  have hl_pos : 0 < 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n) :=
    mul_pos (div_pos two_pos hc) hsin_pos
  have hkey : c * (2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n) / 2) = Real.sin (Real.pi / n) := by
    field_simp
  have harc : Real.arcsin (Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = Real.pi / n :=
    Real.arcsin_sin (by linarith) (by linarith)
  -- moderate arc
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
      (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) := by
    rw [moderateArc_zero_iff]
    intro i
    refine ⟨hl_pos, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simpa [abs_of_pos hc, hkey] using hsin_lt
  -- turning angles
  have hturn : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      turningAngle 0 (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) i
        = 2 * Real.pi / n := by
    intro i
    simp only [turningAngle, tK_zero]
    rw [hkey, harc]
    ring
  -- total turning
  have hsum : turningSum (fun _ : ZMod n => c)
      (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    unfold turningSum
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hturn i, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnpos)]
  -- headings
  have hhead : ∀ j : ℕ,
      heading (fun _ : ZMod n => c) (fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n)) j
        = (j + 1) * (2 * Real.pi / n) := by
    intro j
    unfold heading
    simp only [hturn]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  refine ⟨hMA, hturn, hsum, ?_⟩

  $\theta_i = 2\pi/n$ and $T = n\cdot(2\pi/n) = 2\pi$. Closure: the headings
  are $\psi_j = (j+1)\cdot 2\pi/n$, so
  $E = \ell_0 \sum_{j=0}^{n-1} e^{2\pi i (j+1)/n}
     = \ell_0\, e^{2\pi i/n}\,\frac{e^{2\pi i} - 1}{e^{2\pi i/n} - 1} = 0$
  by the finite geometric series ($e^{2\pi i/n} \neq 1$ for $n \ge 2$).
